correctness.rationale: The fully normalized Gram entries follow by complete-square Gauss sums. Explicit H identities give an orthogonal invariant-block decomposition whose dimensions sum to 3q−2. The residual characteristic polynomial, discriminant, resultant and boundary substitutions have been replayed from the embedded symbolic checker; explicit numeric Gram matrices at ten fields agree. The proof covers every odd prime power; experiments do not establish infinitely many cases.

value.rationale: The chosen linear/chirp coordinate measurements are canonical on the paraboloid, and their exact Riesz constants and equality spaces provide a natural stable Fourier restriction benchmark. The exact two small-field dependencies and the dichotomy between bounded and growing conditioning are substantive infinite-family structural consequences, not a mere new notation for Gauss sums.
